scenarios.text: A mortar shell lands one cell from a colonist crouched behind a sandbag line. The colonist sails about three cells directly away from the impact, clears the sandbags, and lands on the far side. They lie stunned for a moment, wounded but alive.
scenarios.expect: accept: a mortar beside a colonist throws them about three cells away over sandbags, alive and briefly stunned

scenarios.text: A raider tosses a frag grenade that lands right beside a colonist holding a barricade. The colonist is shoved into the barricade and comes to rest on the near side of it, no further from the blast than the barricade line.
scenarios.expect: reject: a thrown person must go over sandbags and barricades, not be stopped by them

scenarios.text: A grenade throws a raider toward an empty patch of floor. While he is in the air, a colonist steps onto the cell he was heading for, and the raider swerves in mid-flight to land on the cell next to it instead.
scenarios.expect: reject: a thrown pawn lands on the cell chosen at the blast and is never re-targeted

scenarios.text: A mortar shell throws a colonist toward the stone wall of the barracks. She hits the wall and bounces back two cells toward the crater before settling.
scenarios.expect: reject: a thrown person stops dead at a wall and takes an impact hit; people never rebound

scenarios.text: A frag grenade goes off between a colonist and a tamed thrumbo (body size 4) on default Mod Settings. The colonist is flung across the yard; the thrumbo flinches from the damage but does not move from its cell.
scenarios.expect: accept: a pawn of body size 2.5 or more (the default) is never thrown

scenarios.text: A grav-ram strikes beside a wild animal of body size 3, and the animal is hurled several cells. A minute later an ordinary frag grenade goes off beside the same animal and it stays where it stood.
scenarios.expect: accept: a weapon's own body-size limit (grav-ram 3.6) lets it throw a pawn bigger than the global 2.5 limit, while other blasts still spare it

scenarios.text: A modded rocket's projectile has its knockback set to zero, while its bomb damage type normally throws. It explodes next to two raiders and both are flung three cells.
scenarios.expect: reject: the projectile's setting wins over the damage type and zero turns the throw off

scenarios.text: A colonist fires a launcher whose impact factor is set to 0. The blast throws a raider into a granite wall; he stops dead on the cell before it and the health tab shows no new injury from hitting the wall.
scenarios.expect: accept: an impact factor of 0 makes that weapon's throws hit walls and pawns harmlessly

scenarios.text: A modded mine whose own maximum throw is set to 2 cells blows up right beside a raider. He is flung four cells, as far as a mortar would throw him, though the global maximum is set higher.
scenarios.expect: reject: a weapon's own maximum caps its throw

scenarios.text: A colonist blasts a charging raider with a shotgun at point-blank range, and the raider is knocked back two cells and staggers. Later a thrumbo's melee charge sends a colonist tumbling a cell.
scenarios.expect: reject: only explosions throw; melee and bullets move nobody

scenarios.text: A grenade lands among three raiders in a storeroom and kills one outright. The loose goods around them fly spinning off the walls, but the dead raider's corpse drops straight down on the cell where he died.
scenarios.expect: reject: loose goods and corpses, a pawn the blast kills among them, fly wild with arc, spin and rebound

scenarios.text: A raider stands two cells from the edge of an open pit when a grenade goes off on his other side. He is carried through the air toward the pit and drops onto its floor.
scenarios.expect: accept: anything thrown toward an open pit falls to its floor

scenarios.text: A mortar shell throws a raider toward a narrow open pit. He flies over it and lands on the floor on the far side, standing again a moment later.
scenarios.expect: reject: nothing is thrown across a pit; a thing thrown toward it falls in

scenarios.text: A colonist hauling steel takes the shortest route to the stockpile, which runs over a covered pit cell. The cover gives way and she drops onto the pit floor.
scenarios.expect: reject: no colonist walks into a pit by ordinary pathing

scenarios.text: A raiding party crosses the colony's outer yard where a pit trap lies hidden under a cover. The lead raider walks onto it and falls in.
scenarios.expect: accept: an enemy may walk into a pit hidden from it

scenarios.text: A colonist lights a flammable gas cloud filling a corridor. The whole cloud erupts at once as one big blast at its middle, flinging every stack in the corridor outward from that one point.
scenarios.expect: reject: gas goes off clump by clump with the fire front, never one centroid blast

scenarios.text: A burning gas cloud reaches a colonist wearing a shield belt. The belt flashes and the colonist stays rooted on her cell while the bursts move goods on either side of her.
scenarios.expect: reject: the gas shove moves a pawn one cell; a shield belt does not stop the shove

scenarios.text: Fire runs through a gas cloud in the workshop, popping it in small bursts one after another. Stacks near each burst scatter a short way, and a colonist standing in the cloud is pushed one cell and has no new wounds.
scenarios.expect: accept: a lit gas cloud goes off clump by clump, scattering goods and shoving people one cell unhurt

scenarios.text: A mortar shell lands beside a wooden crate full of medicine. The crate bursts open and the medicine scatters across the storeroom floor.
scenarios.expect: reject: closed containers keep their goods

scenarios.text: A grenade goes off beside a locker. The locker slides one cell away from the blast into free floor, and when the player opens it all its contents are still inside.
scenarios.expect: accept: closed containers keep their goods and may themselves be shoved a little

scenarios.text: A grenade lands in a storeroom. Stacks on the floor fly off the walls, but everything on the open shelves along the wall stays exactly where it was.
scenarios.expect: reject: open shelves, racks and tables protect nothing; their goods scatter like floor goods

scenarios.text: A mortar shell lands in the middle of a crammed stockpile of about seventy stacks. Most stacks around the crater fly, but a cluster of stacks just as close to the impact sits untouched.
scenarios.expect: reject: every loose good the blast reaches moves; no cap leaves stacks still

scenarios.text: An incendiary mortar shell lands beside two raiders and a pile of wood. Flames spread over the area, but neither the raiders nor the wood move at all.
scenarios.expect: reject: fire and incendiary blasts throw too, at about half strength

scenarios.text: The player halves the throw strength in Mod Settings and closes the menu. The next mortar shell beside a colonist still throws her the same full three cells as before.
scenarios.expect: reject: every Mod Settings line takes effect; a setting that saves but changes nothing fails

scenarios.text: A frag grenade goes off beside a colonist in the yard. She lifts a hand's breadth off the ground, then blinks onto a cell three away from the crater with a little puff of dust, and gets back to her chores once the stun wears off. Nobody saw her actually travel the distance.
scenarios.expect: reject: a thrown pawn must be carried through the air along the throw; a jump to the landing cell is the teleport the arc forbids

scenarios.text: A mortar shell flings a raider against the stone wall of a storeroom. He takes an impact hit and comes to rest about half a cell back from the wall, sliding a little toward the crater before he settles. It looks like a soft, natural landing.
scenarios.expect: reject: a thrown person stops dead at the wall; people never rebound, even a little

scenarios.text: A grenade bursts in a narrow workshop full of loose components and steel. The stacks fly up in high, fast-spinning arcs, but each one simply drops to the floor where it first meets a wall. The room ends up scattered and messy, which the player finds convincing.
scenarios.expect: reject: loose goods rebound off walls keeping about 70 percent each time until spent; stopping at the first wall is a named failure

scenarios.text: A mortar shell lands in a large stockpile. The stacks near the crater sail up spinning and bounce off the walls, while the stacks farther out, still inside the blast, each shift a few cells instantly in the same tick with no flight. Every stack has moved somewhere, so nothing was left sitting still.
scenarios.expect: reject: every good the blast reaches must move by the same flight; far stacks hopping while near ones fly is the cap workaround he removed

scenarios.text: A grenade goes off at the edge of a pit beside a pile of medicine. The medicine stacks wink out at the rim and, a moment later, appear on the pit floor under a puff of dust. They are all there and a colonist can fetch them later.
scenarios.expect: reject: goods never vanish and reappear under a dust puff, even when they end up in the right place

scenarios.text: A frag grenade lands in front of a row of open shelves. Most of the stacks on the shelves fly off and bounce around the room, but the lower stacks on each shelf stay put, as if the shelf frame shielded them. The shelves are visibly half emptied.
scenarios.expect: reject: open shelves, racks and tables protect nothing; every stack on them scatters like floor goods

scenarios.text: Fire runs through a flammable gas cloud in a corridor, popping it in small bursts one after another. Each burst scatters nearby goods a short way and pushes a colonist standing in the cloud one cell, and each push leaves a fresh bruise on her health tab. She is otherwise fine.
scenarios.expect: reject: a gas clump shoves a person one cell with no damage; a bruise from the shove is damage

scenarios.text: A leak of the Cauldron's gas drifts across a stockroom and a spark catches it. The gas burns away as an ordinary spreading fire, scorching the floor, but nothing pops and no stack is moved. Elsewhere a different flammable gas does go off in bursts.
scenarios.expect: reject: the Cauldron's gas carries the flammable tag and must go off clump by clump like the others

scenarios.text: Raiders line up on a covered pit trap. A frag grenade over one end breaks the cover and a raider drops in; an incendiary shell over the other end sets the cover ablaze but leaves it whole, and the raiders on it run off burning. The trap worked where it mattered.
scenarios.expect: reject: a fire blast breaks a pit cover as well as a damaging one; a fire blast leaving the cover whole is a named failure

scenarios.text: An incendiary shell lands beside a raider and a pile of wood. The raider is thrown, but only about half as far as a frag shell threw his comrade a moment earlier, and the wood stacks scatter a shorter way too before flames spread. The weaker throw looks almost underpowered.
scenarios.expect: accept: every harmful blast throws, fire and incendiary at half strength; a shorter throw from fire is the ruled behaviour

control.note: tree without wall_stops_dead and sheet with every mention of the people-at-a-wall rule stripped (does line, the 'as at a wall' clause, two pruning reasons, the later line, the impact-factor wall wording, the root ek_wall_stops_hard); the control reader accepted ['c2'] of the wall scenarios ['e4', 'c2'] (it rejected e4 through pawn_flight_arc's planned landing cell, a residual overlap); it also read a commit subject outside its three files, which named an earlier control leaf, not this one
